data.name: Zephyr’s Judgment
data.description: This technique has been passed down by several ninja of old times. By achieving control of the wind nature, the user can subjugate the winds around his fists and legs, generating incredible attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user enters a wind-infused trance, closing the gap to %target in an instant. Each rapid punch and kick creates miniature cyclones, shredding %target’s defenses and leaving them immobilized.

data.name: Abyssal Surge
data.description: A brutal water-based jutsu that enhances the user’s power while absorbing strength through every strike.
data.battleDescription: %user steadies their breath, water beginning to churn and rise from the ground like a tide answering a silent call. Abyssal Surge engulfs their body in dense, high-pressure chakra drawn from oceanic depths. As the aura wraps tightly around their limbs and core, it sharpens their strikes and hardens their defense. Each enemy blow is dulled, absorbed into the fluid barrier before it reaches flesh. In this state, the user becomes both sharper and harder to strike—a relentless force riding the surge of the abyss.

data.battleDescription: %user conjures a raging vortex of water, engulfing %target in relentless, churning currents.

data.battleDescription: %user summons coiling flames that wrap around %target, searing them relentlessly.

data.name: Inferno Kick
data.description: A flame-infused kick that burns on impact and continues searing over time
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into their leg, the limb igniting in a blaze that roars with each step. With a swift leap and a violent spin, they deliver a flaming kick to %target, the impact erupting in a burst of searing heat. The flames cling to the point of contact, continuing to burn and inflict damage over time.

data.name: Midare
data.description: A relentless barrage that deals damage and allows the user to absorb incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls forward into a whirlwind of motion, striking %target with a rapid barrage of kunai infused with water chakra. Each slash and throw disrupts the opponent's rhythm while thin currents of chakra swirl around %user’s body. With every movement, the surrounding moisture condenses into a protective flow, allowing them to absorb some of the damage from incoming attacks.

data.name: Electric Prison
data.description: An electrifying genjutsu that deals damage and stuns the target.
data.battleDescription: With a surge of chakra and a flicker of illusion, %user traps %target in a prison of blinding lightning. The phantom bolts lash at their senses, sending jolts of searing pain through their body. Paralyzed and overwhelmed, the target is unable to move as the crackling current locks down both body and mind.

Their movements become erratic, trying to escape the non-existent flames, leaving them vulnerable to %user next attack.

Within moments, the enemy is trapped in a howling illusion, disoriented by phantom winds that lash and rip at their senses. The mental strain tears at their resistance, leaving their mind raw and far more susceptible to incoming genjutsu. What began as a single storm becomes a gateway for future torment.

data.name: Petrification Mirage
data.description: Makes enemy believe they are turning to stone.
data.battleDescription: %user casts a genjutsu that makes %target feel their body gradually turning to stone. Starting from their extremities, %target experiences a creeping numbness and rigidity, spreading slowly to their core. The fear of becoming completely petrified grips %target, causing their movements to become erratic and hesitant as they struggle against the illusory transformation

The momentum fuels their dominant offensive strength and heightens overall combat readiness, while the burning mark left on %target leaves them exposed to further punishment from that same specialty.

The quake reverberates through their muscles and joints, disrupting chakra flow and weakening their ability to strike back. %target’s Taijutsu and Bukijutsu become sluggish, their strength dulled and movements slowed.

The impact echoes like stone slamming into steel, staggering the opponent and disrupting their ability to channel power. The force of the strike not only causes direct physical damage but saps their offensive momentum, reducing the strength of their follow-up attacks.

data.name: Stormguard Retaliation

data.battleDescription: %user channels volatile lightning chakra through their body, then unleashes it in a piercing strike toward %target. The surge lashes out with punishing force and activates a lifesteal effect, allowing the user to recover health from upcoming damage they infl

The fiery bonds sear into their flesh with each movement, warping their senses and igniting phantom pain that continues to ravage their body over time.

data.name: Aqua Serpent Strike
data.description: A fluid, water-based taijutsu strike that lashes the target and leaves them more susceptible to damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra through their limbs, shaping it into a sinuous, whip-like flow around their arm. The impact disorients the enemy’s defenses, soaking them in reactive chakra that lingers like venom—heightening the damage they suffer from subsequent attacks. The strike is silent, swift, and merciless—like the serpent it’s named for.

Flames snake through %target’s muscles, disrupting their physical strength, slowing their reflexes, and softening their taijutsu guard. As the embers cling to %user, their own strikes begin to blaze hotter and hit harder.

The backlash ignites within %user, feeding off their resolve and amplifying their ninjutsu to monstrous levels. The very atmosphere trembles, as if acknowledging their unleashed wrath.

data.name: Tornado Fist

The blow lands with explosive force against %target, tearing at their stance and disrupting their physical core. The turbulence doesn’t fade—it lingers. Wind chakra burrows beneath the skin and into muscle memory, destabilizing their ability to brace. With their guard thrown off balance, %target becomes far more vulnerable to follow-up taijutsu.

data.name: Chouryū Ken

As the punch ascends, it forms the shape of a roaring dragon made entirely of water, propelling %user into the air. The soaked terrain beneath them churns from the pressure, marking the devastating path left behind by the Soaring Dragon Fist.

data.name: Endless Drowning

A powerful genjutsu that overwhelms the target’s senses with the illusion of being pulled into an infinite, drowning ocean.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL

Panic and helplessness set in as the illusion traps the target’s mind in an endless descent.

data.description: A cursed chakra technique that deals direct damage by tearing through the enemy’s spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures cursed chakra chains and hurls them at %target. Upon contact, the chains pierce through physical defenses and latch onto the target’s spirit, delivering a crushing blow to their core. The pain is sharp and sudden, striking deeper than the flesh and rattling their chakra from within.

data.name: Sonic Slash
data.description: A high-speed slash that pierces defenses with precision.
data.battleDescription: %user channels vibrating sound chakra into their blade and vanishes in a burst of movement. As the weapon cuts through the air, it releases a sharp sonic wave that tears into %target with amplified force. The strike disrupts balance, pierces armor, and leaves behind a ringing pulse that echoes through the target’s body.

data.name: Searing Might
data.description: A blazing chakra technique that hardens the user’s body, reducing incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense chakra into their core, igniting it into a controlled blaze that spreads through their body. The heat reinforces their muscles and chakra pathways, forming a shield of inner strength. As attacks come in, the energy absorbs and deflects the impact, allowing the user to withstand damage with unshakable resolve.

data.name: Beast Claw Illusion
data.description: A savage again due to that strikes the enemies mind and boost the users damage output
data.battleDescription: %user casts Beast Claw Illusion, rending %target’s mind with phantom fangs and fury, while their own bloodlust surges with enhanced power.

data.name: Earth Release: Palm Push
data.description: A defensive jutsu that decreases damage taken and redirects enemy offensive output.
data.battleDescription: With a grounded stance, %user channels earth chakra into their palm before thrusting forward. A sudden wave of solid force erupts, intercepting the enemy’s attack and dispersing its power. This technique reduces the damage received while subtly shifting the incoming force, displacing the enemy or altering their trajectory with controlled redirection.

data.name: Danse Macabre
data.description: Summon spectral blades that target the opponents chakra points.
data.battleDescription: Spectral blades erupt from %user in a ghostly bloom, drifting like phantoms through the air. They scatter around %target before suddenly arcing inward with eerie grace, piercing chakra points and inhibiting the flow of chakra.

data.name: Crimson Tides
data.description:
A violent chakra wave that drains the enemy’s life, restoring the user with every strike.

data.name: Aqua Fang
data.description: A precise water-based strike that deals damage and boosts the user’s offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user darts forward and slashes with a weapon wreathed in jagged water chakra, striking %target with a snapping surge. As the attack lands, streams of chakra coil around their body, heightening the force behind their next assaults.

data.name: Medusa's Gaze
data.description: A mythical Genjutsu that powers up the user's abilities by channeling the power of Medusa.
data.battleDescription: %user locks their eyes and begins channeling their Chakra. After a brief moment, the opponent opens their eyes. Revealing a powerful yellow gaze that amplifiesthe opponent 's genjutsu powers by channeling Medusa's power into them.

data.name: Cauterize
data.description: Burn away your impurities and close your wounds with searing chakra.

data.battleDescription: %user's hands glow with dancing red chakra as they press them against their wounds. The intense heat sears the skin, closing the wounds and burning away negative energy. Minor burns remain across %user's hands and arms.

data.name: Inferno Burst
data.description: A focused eruption of flame that burns the enemy and leaves them vulnerable to future ninjutsu attacks
data.battleDescription: %user expels a high-speed blast of condensed fire chakra that detonates on impact with %target, scorching their body and chakra network. The heat lingers, disrupting their chakra defenses and increasing the damage they take from future ninjutsu techniques.

data.name: Great Fire Annihilation
data.description: The user creates a blade of fire, the flames of which spread horizontally ahead of them.
data.battleDescription: %user kneads an immense amount of chakra within their body and converts it into fire-natured chakra. Upon release, they expel a colossal torrent of flames from their mouth, shaping it into a vast, ocean-like inferno that spreads across the battlefield.

data.name: Chakra Overflow
data.description: A potent chakra buff that enhances all offensive abilities and raises the user’s stats.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in waves—thick, radiant, and barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. Simultaneously, the user’s core stats spike, fueling their body and mind for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It’s the edge between control and chaos—a moment where the user becomes a living conduit of power.

data.name: Senbon Sakura
data.description: Shatter your blade into millions of tiny senbons.
data.battleDescription: %user presses their palm on their sword, the blade shatters and a thousand tiny flowers with sharp edges are sent flying towards %target. As the shards pierce %target, tiny specs of blood form from each entrance.

data.name: Arashi Ikari
data.description: A stormborn genjutsu that damages the enemy and increases the damage they take.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a storm of phantom lightning in %target’s mind. The mental assault deals damage and leaves %target more vulnerable to subsequent attacks.

data.name: Eternal Darkness
data.description: Blind your foe in a shroud of darkness decreasing the effectiveness of their damage
data.battleDescription: %user performs various hand scenes and a veil of darkness surrounds %target blocking their ability to see %user

data.name: Earthquake Fist
data.description: A powerful earth-infused punch that strikes the enemy and locks them in place.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their fist into %target with enough force to rupture the ground beneath them. The impact triggers a seismic shock that roots the target where they stand, locking their movement with raw force and stone pressure.

data.name: Thunder's Phantom
data.description: This sinister Lightning Genjutsu conjures a spectral storm, where ghostly bolts of lightning flicker and dance around the target.
data.battleDescription: %user manipulates their chakra, causing the air around %target to crackle with an ominous energy. Ghostly bolts of lightning flicker into existence, circling %target with an eerie, unpredictable rhythm. The haunting sound of thunder roars in the distance, growing closer and louder, disorienting %target's senses. With each flash, %target’s body instinctively tenses, feeling the phantom shock of electricity that never truly lands, yet leaves a lingering paralysis. Caught between the illusion and the threat of real danger, %target is left vulnerable, their mind spinning in fear and confusion, unable to discern where the next strike will come from.

data.name: Aqua Fist
data.description: Forms water around the fists for devastating punches.
data.battleDescription: %user's fists, surrounded by swirling, hardened water, unleash a barrage of punches at %target, each strike hitting with the force of crashing waves, disrupting their chakra flow and leaving them vulnerable.

data.name: Storm Kick
data.description: A piercing lightning kick that propels the user and reflects a portion of damage received back to the attacker.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into their leg, their form crackling with unstable voltage. With a flash of movement, they launch forward across the battlefield like a bolt breaking loose from a thundercloud. The kick lands cleanly against %target, piercing through their guard with razor precision. But the technique doesn’t stop there—Storm Kick leaves a current behind, wrapping the user in reactive lightning. For a short time, any damage aimed at %user arcs back toward the attacker, punishing them for every blow.

data.name: Summoning: Lord Pengu
data.description: The people of Glacier have cohabitated with the Ancient Penguins and have earned the favor of Lord Pengu
data.battleDescription: %user pricks their finger and slams their hand to the ground. A cold mist swirls before condensing into a crowned penguin.

data.name: Rejuvenating Chakra
data.description: A focused healing technique that restores the user’s health through controlled chakra flow.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and channels chakra inward, guiding it through key points to accelerate recovery. Wounds close, fatigue fades, and their body regains strength as restorative chakra pulses through them.

data.name: Wind Style: Sky Dragon
data.description: A piercing wind dragon that tears through enemies, inflicting wound damage that continues to bleed over time.
data.battleDescription: A furious gust howls as %user thrusts their palms toward the heavens, molding chakra into a colossal dragon of cutting wind. The creature coils above, its translucent form shimmering like glass before diving with a deafening roar. Its spiraling body tears through the air, slicing everything in its path as it drives straight through %target. The impact leaves deep, invisible wounds that continue to rip and bleed under the lingering force of the gale.

data.name: Boulder Barrage
data.description: Manipulates the earth to launch a barrage of massive boulders at the enemy, causing significant damage upon impact
data.battleDescription: %user summons a series of towering boulders, launching them at %target with devastating force.

data.name: Blazing Reprisal
data.description: A fiery barrier that  swarms the target absorbing there lifeforce while scorching them.
data.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a fiery barrier that absorbs a portion of %target’s health,  while searing them in immense heat

data.name: Rengoku Rō
data.description: A devastating genjutsu attack that overwhelms the opponent’s mind with intense illusionary torment.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and channels overwhelming genjutsu energy, summoning a fiery illusion that consumes reality around the victim. Walls of flame twist into phantasmal figures, dragging %target into an endless mental prison of agony and despair. Every sensory input is distorted, disorienting the enemy and leaving their will fractured under the crushing weight of illusionary suffering.

data.name: Verdant Renewal
data.description: Envelops the target in nature’s healing aura.
data.battleDescription: %user kneels and places their palms on the ground, channeling energy into the earth. Vines and blossoms emerge, wrapping gently around %user or %target. The vibrant greenery pulses with life, knitting injuries together and restoring vitality. The sweet scent of blooming flowers enhances the target’s resolve, filling them with newfound strength and focus.

data.name: Volt Crash
data.description: A high-speed lightning charge that crashes into the enemy with explosive force.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a flash of lightning, covering the battlefield in an instant. With thunderclap velocity, they slam into %target like a living bolt, delivering a crushing impact that leaves sparks and destruction in their wake.

data.name: Rising Water Slicer
data.description: The user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds to its target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds towards %target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.

data.name: Force Wave
data.description: A shockwave of raw chakra that deals damage and disrupts the enemy’s physical might and mobilit
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a concentrated blast of raw force chakra that crashes into %target like a wall of pressure. The impact scatters their momentum, suppressing their ability to move or strike with power, and reducing their speed, strength, and effectiveness in both bukijutsu and taijutsu.

data.name: Quaking Mallet
data.description: A powerful Earth Bukijutsu technique that involves striking the ground with a chakra-infused weapon, creating shockwaves that resonate through the earth and destabilize the ground beneath the target.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their mallet into the ground, sending a surge of chakra deep into the earth. The ground beneath %target begins to shake violently, cracks forming around them as the terrain becomes increasingly unstable. The quakes grow stronger with each passing moment, forcing %target to constantly adjust their stance to avoid being toppled or trapped by the shifting earth.

data.name: Fire Release: Dragon Punch
data.description: A fiery punch that conjures a dragon's head.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into their fist, unleashing a blazing punch that forms a roaring dragon of fire, engulfing %target and scorching everything in its path.

data.name: Quicksand Trap
data.description: The illusion drowns the enemy in endless sands, weakening their assault and dulling their senses.
data.battleDescription: The user calmly weaves a deceptive genjutsu, casting the illusion of the ground collapsing beneath the enemy into a churning pit of quicksand. Within the mirage, the sands twist and coil, dragging the target downward as invisible pressure grinds at their body and mind. Their perception of movement slows, their senses dulled by the crushing despair. Meanwhile, the user gains a protective clarity, their awareness sharpened against oncoming attacks. The result is a mirage that defends the caster while eroding the will and health of the target.

data.name: Wave Cleaver
data.description: A powerful strike that unleashes a cleaving wave of water, dealing heavy damage.
data.battleDescription: %user swings their weapon in a wide arc, releasing a massive surge of compressed water chakra that rips toward %target. The cutting wave crashes forward like a tidal blade, delivering overwhelming force in a single sweeping motion.

data.name: Seal of Nullification
data.description: A sealing technique that suppresses buffs and enhancement abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate seals in the air, summoning glowing ethereal chains that surge toward %target, coiling tightly to disrupt their chakra flow, stripping away buffs and suppressing any attempts to invoke new enhancements.

data.name: Sealing Blade
data.description: This forbidden sword technique showcases the ability to not only impress upon the the immaculate cutting ability but to target another's chakra points with the blade as well.
data.battleDescription: As %user faces their adversary, a dangerous glint in their eye, they unleash Intercepting Blade, a forbidden sword technique of immense power. With a swift, expert strike, %user's blade cuts through the air with deadly precision, aiming not just for the body, but for the very chakra pathways of %target. As the blade connects, %target reels, the disruption causing them intense pain and confusion. %user presses the advantage, their mastery of swordsmanship and chakra control evident in every move, leaving %target incapacitated without their chakra.

data.name: Seimyaku
data.description: A subtle pulse of chakra that suppresses enemy recovery while shielding the user from harm
data.battleDescription: %user emits a deep, controlled pulse of refined chakra that interferes with %target’s ability to recover while reinforcing their own defenses. The technique dampens restorative energies around the enemy and surrounds the user in a chakra field that cushions incoming attacks.

data.name: Fan Dance
data.description: Empowers the user's fan with wind chakra, unveiling the Fan Dance, a graceful yet deadly technique.
data.battleDescription: %user infuses their fan with wind chakra, performing a Fan Dance that amplifies their wind-based abilities.

data.name: Blazing Prison
data.description: This formidable genjutsu encases the target's mind in the illusion of being trapped within an impenetrable dome of flames.
data.battleDescription: After weaving hand seals, %user locks their gaze on %target, who suddenly perceives themselves trapped in an inescapable inferno. The searing flames scorch their body, dealing damage, while the overwhelming heat and terror leave %target stunned, unable to act.

data.name: Abyssal Suffocation
data.description: A drowning illusion that saps the enemy’s vitality and rejuvenates the caster.
data.battleDescription: With a simple seal and a piercing gaze, the user traps %target in a genjutsu where the ocean turns against them. Water crashes down in suffocating waves as spectral tides pull them into an abyss of pressure and despair. As %target gasps for air within the illusion, the user draws strength from their suffering—regaining vitality with every heartbeat stolen beneath the surface.

data.name: Shadow Tendril Technique
data.description: Manipulates shadows to create tendrils that can sap the energy of an opponent, similar to threads of darkness.
data.battleDescription: %user's shadow extends, forming inky tendrils that ensnare %target, sapping their strength and leaving them exposed to further attacks.

data.name: Heaven's Blessing
data.description: User summons chakra from the sky to weaken their target
data.battleDescription: %user summons chakra from the sky to weaken %target

data.name: Carnation Tarnation
data.description: Your bizarre energy lashes out at foes
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes the chakra they've been trying to control which seems to have a mind of its own, lashing out at those who at attack %target

data.name: Chakra Resistance
data.description: A chakra reinforcement technique that hardens the body and improves resistance to damage.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses inward, layering dense chakra throughout their body. The reinforced flow cushions incoming damage and strengthens their defenses, allowing them to endure attacks with greater resilience.

data.name: Prismatic Ward
data.description: A defensive chakra field that hinders foes and bolsters power.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into an intricate geometric prism, its multifaceted surfaces shimmering with vibrant energy. As the prism solidifies, its aura disrupts %target's focus, diminishing their ability to channel chakra effectively. Meanwhile, %user’s chakra resonates with the prism, amplifying their own potency for an impending assault.

data.battleDescription: %user conjures a shield of swirling water that absorbs incoming attacks, converting their force into chakra restoration.

data.name: Gale Echo
data.description: Uses the sound of wind to create disorienting echoes.
data.battleDescription: %user manipulates the wind to carry disorienting echoes that reverberate around %target. The constant shifting and echoing sounds make it difficult for %target to pinpoint %user’s location or predict their movements. Confused and overwhelmed by the auditory illusions, %target is left vulnerable to %user’s next move.

data.name: Flame Crescent Slash
data.description: A wide and fiery slash that releases a crescent-shaped flame towards the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense fire chakra into their blade and unleashes a wide, flaming arc aimed directly at %target. The searing crescent tears across the battlefield in a blazing trail, striking with devastating force and leaving a charred path in its wake.

data.name: Scorching Kick
data.description: A powerful kick engulfed in flames, causing severe burn damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fiery chakra into their leg, delivering a high kick that engulfs %target in blazing flames. The impact crushes %target with intense force, while the searing heat leaves them severely burned and weakened.

data.name: Pressure Damage
data.description: his tornado-like mass is compressed until it has a very high density before being released.
data.battleDescription: %user generates intense atmospheric pressure, weighing down %target and diminishing their abilities.

data.name: Cyclone Fists
data.description: A devastating cyclone punch that slashes through enemies, dealing damage and crippling their Offence, Strength and Speed.
data.battleDescription: The air warps around %user as they gather immense chakra into their fists, the pressure building until the ground quakes beneath their stance. With a violent roar, they drive their punch forward — unleashing a colossal cyclone that spirals across the battlefield. The vortex screams with razor-sharp winds, tearing through the air before slamming into %target. The impact shreds balance and focus alike, leaving their body cut, staggered, and their physical strength fading under the storm’s relentless force.

data.name: Blinding Chakra Strike
data.description: This forbidden jutsu taps into the very essence of chakra, manifesting a spectral dragon made of pure energy. The dragon's form shimmers with ethereal power, exuding an aura that disrupts the flow of chakra in the area.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra, delivering a devastating strike infused with blinding light directly at %target. The impact creates a dazzling explosion, enveloping %target in a blinding glare that disrupts their chakra control. The intense light causes disorientation, making it challenging for %target to maintain their focus and execute precise Genjutsu techniques.

data.name: Inferno Phantom
data.description: Conjures a vision of a hellish landscape to terrify and disorient.
data.battleDescription: With a swift motion, %user performs a series of complex hand seals, their eyes gleaming with a fiery light. The air around %target shimmers, then transforms into a vision of a burning wasteland. The ground cracks open, spewing lava and molten rock. %target is paralyzed by the fear of being consumed by the inferno, their mind overwhelmed by the nightmarish scene, rendering them incapacitated and exposed.

data.name: Drowning Illusion
data.description: Traps the target in a water illusion, dealing damage and weakening their ability to fight back.
data.battleDescription: The user casts a haunting illusion that submerges %target in a false, inescapable flood. Panic takes hold as phantom waters rise around them, distorting their senses and draining their will to strike back. Every motion feels heavier, every breath more desperate, weakening their ability to launch effective attacks.

data.name: Life Release: Spirit Wall
data.description: A forbidden technique that converts the user’s life force into a massive chakra barrier capable of withstanding devastating attacks. Though immensely powerful, the technique rapidly drains the vitality of its user
data.battleDescription: %user sacrifices their life force as crimson chakra erupts around them, forming a massive chakra barrier covered in glowing sigils. The blood-forged wall withstands incoming attacks while waves of violent chakra surge from %user’s body.

data.name: Adamantine Fortress
data.description: A defensive earth-style jutsu that raises barriers to protect the user and reduce damage taken.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, channeling earth chakra outward in all directions. Thick stone walls erupt around them in a rapid formation—dense, layered, and reinforced with chakra. These barriers deflect incoming strikes and dull the force of enemy attacks. While active, the user’s body is further reinforced by lingering stone chakra, allowing them to absorb more punishment than usual

data.name: Inferno Dragon's Wrath
data.description: A blazing dragon-shaped assault that deals damage and burns the enemy over time.
data.battleDescription: %user roars with force as a colossal dragon of living fire erupts from their chakra, crashing into %target with scorching fury. The blazing heat continues to cling to the enemy, searing them long after the initial impact.

data.name: Shadow Labyrinth
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and enhances the user’s Offence, Intelligence and Willpower.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a slow, deliberate sequence of hand seals as shadows crawl from beneath their feet. The battlefield shifts into an endless, twisting labyrinth of darkness—walls shifting, corridors looping, and the horizon collapsing into infinite void. Within this illusion, the opponent stumbles, their thoughts ensnared by confusion and fear. As their mind falters, %user’s presence grows more menacing, their genjutsu prowess sharpened by the very fear they instilled. Every moment trapped inside amplifies %user’s mental dominance, elevating their Offence, Intelligence and Willpower.

data.name: Aqua Prison
data.description: Encasing themselves in swirling water, the user reduces incoming damage while empowering their strikes with greater force.
data.battleDescription: Water surges around %user, forming a dense sphere that clings tightly to their body. The flowing barrier absorbs the force of incoming attacks, reducing damage taken, while chakra-infused currents surge through %user’s limbs, amplifying the power of their counterattacks.

data.name: Fire Talon
data.description: Taijutsu that decreases stats and increases damage taken.
data.battleDescription: The user channels intense chakra into their leg and performs a flaming roundhouse kick that halts just short of contact. The sudden surge of heat and pressure disorients the opponent's body, lowering their overall stats and leaving them more vulnerable to incoming attacks. Though it doesn't inflict direct damage, its purpose is to break defenses and create an opening.N

data.name: Inferno Kunai Barrage

data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a relentless stream of flaming kunai at %target, each one carving through the air with searing heat. The scorching impacts ignite lingering flames that continue to burn %target.

data.name: Ethereal Nexus
data.description: A nexus of elements siphons life from the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a radiant nexus of elemental energy, unleashing devastating forces on %target and siphoning their life force into %user at the cost of taking extra damage.

data.name: Thunder Shockwave
data.description: A concussive burst of lightning that strikes hard and leaves the enemy paralyzed.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their palm to the ground, unleashing a booming pulse of lightning chakra that radiates in all directions. The blast cracks the earth and engulfs %target in a sudden shockwave, paralyzing their muscles mid-motion as the electric surge locks their body in place.

data.name: Dragon Breath
data.description: A brutal fire attack that deals damage and applies a burning damage over time effect
data.battleDescription: %user exhales Dragon Breath in a torrent of hellfire, engulfing %target in searing flames that continue to devour them long after the initial strike.

data.name: Raijin Puncture
data.description: Honing your ability to manipulate lightning, this jutsu allows you to summon bolts of lightning, striking down your enemy.
data.battleDescription: As %user charges up, white lightning crackles around their body, intensifying around their fist. In a flash, %user dashes toward %target, delivering a charged lightning punch to their chest. The impact releases a blinding discharge of energy, electrocuting %target and causing severe damage.

data.name: Stone Hammer Kick
data.description: A crushing earth-infused kick that deals heavy damage and fortifies the user’s defense.
data.battleDescription: %user reinforces their leg with dense earth chakra, then launches into a spinning downward kick that slams into %target like a falling slab of stone. Upon impact, shockwaves ripple through the ground, and fragments of hardened chakra recoil around %user’s body. These chakra shards linger like a shell, absorbing impact and dulling incoming attacks.

data.name: Storm Fist
data.description: A powerful punch enveloped in a swirling vortex of lightning.
data.battleDescription: %user channels storm energy into their fist, lightning spiraling around their arm as they strike %target with a crushing blow, releasing a violent explosion of light and sound that sends them flying and leaves them overwhelmed and vulnerable.

data.name: Tempest of the Blade
data.description: The user creates a large, blade-shaped construct of pure wind chakra, which can be wielded as a weapon or launched at the target with tremendous force.
data.battleDescription: As %user focuses their chakra, the air around them becomes charged with energy, swirling into a tempest. With a mighty swing, %user unleashes this tempest upon %target, the blade cutting through the air with a deafening roar. The tempest strikes %target with the force of a raging storm, dealing devastating damage.

data.name: Subaku Palace
